idea-plugin.name: Optics Framework
idea-plugin.description:
Diagnostics, completion, hover, parameter info, goto-definition, find usages, cross-file rename, structure view and semantic highlighting for optics-framework CSV test suites.

Everything is project-wide: a name defined in one CSV resolves references in every other file in the project.

Requires Python 3.12 or newer on PATH, or configured under Settings | Tools | Optics Framework. The language server's own dependencies ship inside this plugin.
